items.name: Live Interactive Map
items.description: Real-time stream health map with color-coded markers (green/yellow/red). Click markers for sensor data and historical charts. Interactive, zoomable, filterable. The #1 demo feature judges will see first.
items.tech: Leaflet.js, Mapbox, OGC SensorThings API, real-time WebSocket streaming

items.name: AI Copilot Chat Interface
items.description: A chat-like AI assistant that helps users interpret stream health results. 'Why is the stream stressed?' → AI explains using OneAquaHealth factsheets. 'What should I do next?' → AI gives actionable recommendations. Connected to LLM API (Groq/OpenRouter/HuggingFace).
items.tech: Groq/OpenRouter API, React chat UI, OneAquaHealth factsheet knowledge base

items.name: Predictive Timeline Chart
items.description: Show stream health trajectory: 'was → is → will be'. LSTM model predicting pH/DO/turbidity for next 6-48 hours. The 'AI-Supported Assessment' core of Track 3. Real-time prediction updates.
items.tech: TensorFlow.js LSTM, Recharts time-series, real-time data streaming

items.name: One-Click PDF Report Generator
items.description: Click 'Generate Report' → produces a professional PDF. Includes: assessment tier, evidence, citations, recommendations, charts. Ready for EPA/regulatory submission. This is what makes it real-world usable.
items.tech: PDFKit/html2pdf, report templates, EPA STORET/WQX format export

items.name: Citizen Science Interactive Map
items.description: Community members drop pins on the map. Report observations, photos, GPS coordinates. Real-time feed of community reports. This is the social impact feature that makes it hackathon-worthy.
items.tech: Leaflet.js marker clustering, IndexedDB offline storage, photo capture, geolocation
